messages:
ana: Starting thread for the docs PR migrating console presets/examples to metrics_v2. I ran the automated converter and hit three blockers: a dead playground link, tracehook losing empty trace_key, and the heatmap example using old cost field naming.
chris: drop the PR link here when you have it. I can pick up the redirect.
devops-bot: Suggest replacing dead link with https://console.redwood.ai/playground. Filed infra ticket REDW-1214 for redirect.
nana: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5099 - CI failed on examples job with a TypeError in the sample renderer for tracehook.
ci-bot: examples pipeline: TypeError: expected str for trace_key, got None.
sam: the converter strips nulls; we should emit an explicit empty string for trace_key. Also note span_sampling changed shape (bool -> object).
nana: proposing YAML patch in PR (excerpt): ```yaml
presets:
  - name: kv-latency-heatmap
    metrics_schema: v2
    tracehook:
      trace_key: ""
      span_sampling:
        strategy: probabilistic
        rate: 0.01
    blocks:
      - type: heatmap
        metric: latency.p95
        cost_mode: normalized
```
chris: good. I'll update the dead URL and tweak the legend note about cost_mode semantics. Also replacing SDK snippets using `cost_per_token` with `unit_cost.tokens` in a follow-up.
nana: added checklist to PR for manual example render and left migration note: "span_sampling changed from bool to object; empty trace_key should be an empty string; cost_per_token renamed to unit_cost.tokens".
ci-bot: re-run queued by @ana.
chris: reviewed, left one nit on wording.
sam: approved after nit fix.
ci-bot: CI passed, examples render ok.
nana: merged. Follow-up tasks: REDW-1215 sweep SDK snippets for cost field rename, REDW-1214 infra redirect. Thanks everyone!
